newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi port opens five new piers.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi port opens five new piers.

text.p: The Abu Dhabi Ports Authority on Tuesday opened five new piers at the city's Sheikh Zaid port to increase capacity as part of its development efforts, the official WAM news agency said.
Ports Authority undersecretary Hassan Ramzi said the new additions raised the number of piers to nine.

He said container traffic through the port had increased more than five-fold from 1991 to 1995, rising from 45,000 tonnes to 246,000 tonnes. He said general cargo had increased from 560,000 tonnes to 1.2 million tonnes during the same period.
Total tonnage rose from 816,000 tonnes to four million tonnes from 1991 to 1995, he said.
